depiction_rules.notes: Provisional D033 visual entity contract for the apparition Durvasa creates in stanza 5 and the Sudarshana destroys in stanza 6; not an approved character master.

visual_bible.form: one clearly humanoid, non-human spirit with a single head, a distinct torso and connected limbs
visual_bible.face: fierce but not monstrous, with no duplicated eyes or mouths
visual_bible.skin: muted burnt-ochre and deep maroon mineral pigment, with a matte flame-like edge
visual_bible.hair: a rough dark mane echoing the matted hair from which it is conjured
visual_bible.build: compact, readable silhouette; naturally connected two arms and two legs
visual_bible.weapon: one clearly held sword with an uninterrupted hand-to-hilt connection
visual_bible.continuity_markers: the same single apparition appears only once; the chakra disperses it without gore

anatomy_contract.rule: single apparition, no duplicate bodies or detached weapon hands
